purpose: Machine-readable ownership and evidence index for every tracked Tactevra AI test module.

workstreams.title: Intent parsing, local language-model research, and semantic compilation
workstreams.objective: Convert supported user text into an exact semantic ActionPlan or an explicit rejection without model-created payload substitution.
workstreams.current_result: The deterministic grounded path is the intent reference; response-SFT candidates remain research because frozen evaluations contain wrong executable proposals or coverage regressions.
limitations: Finite grammar coverage is narrower than general English.
No language-model checkpoint is authorized to bypass deterministic compilation or admission.
workstreams.next_gate: Freeze a new intent benchmark before changing model or admission policy, and retain exact false-execution and supported-request coverage metrics.

workstreams.title: Offline scene observation, image quality, capture binding, and fusion
workstreams.objective: Bind exact image bytes to device presence, visibility, quality, obstruction, and fail-closed scene decisions.
workstreams.current_result: Geometry-first fusion removes every v16 replayed self-occlusion miss by construction. The separately frozen residual pretraining design now defines 1,200 target crops across cable, tool, hand, foreign-object, glare, degradation, clear, and adjacent-distractor cases with pose-separated synthetic train/development identities; no crops or model have been generated yet.
limitations: No commissioned projection renderer, measured dilation artifact, or physical deployment qualification is installed.
The geometry-first replay uses the same Isaac semantic mask that generated the synthetic label and therefore cannot estimate real projection error.
Residual campaign sources are two correlated synthetic practice views with simplified surfaces and an unmeasured camera.
The failed v16 learned checkpoint has no installable uncertainty bound and cannot be evaluated or promoted.
Scene and projection evidence cannot substitute for localization uncertainty, collision screening, or arm-runtime admission.
The v16 corpus contains 320 correlated static states from one governed path and does not qualify arbitrary poses, the camera, or deployment.
workstreams.next_gate: Generate the exact frozen residual crops, verify them independently, train the declared small offline model, and apply the target-cluster development gate without opening evaluation; commission synchronized measured-feedback projection and physical parked-pose evidence in parallel.

workstreams.title: Keyboard pose training, localization evaluation, and uncertainty research
workstreams.objective: Estimate keyboard placement and orientation, derive named-key coordinates, and quantify uncertainty without promoting synthetic results as physical calibration.
workstreams.current_result: The translation-weighted checkpoint improved synthetic development error, but the retained conservative adapter bound is 14.400834977 mm and no deployment qualification is installed.
limitations: Synthetic renderer evidence does not establish final-camera performance.
The current bound crosses ordinary key safe regions.
workstreams.next_gate: Run the frozen model on disjoint final-camera calibration and held-out captures, then require composed uncertainty to fit per-target safe regions.

workstreams.title: Precision observations and ordered ModelMotionBatch production
workstreams.objective: Convert qualified named-target observations into strict, ordered, evidence-bound ModelMotionBatch proposals.
workstreams.current_result: Strict v2 production preserves semantic action order and exact evidence identities and abstains when localization is unqualified.
limitations: The producer accepts supplied observations and is not a complete live camera pipeline.
No servo, PWM, transport, permit, or success authority is present.
workstreams.next_gate: Supply a physically qualified precision observation and replay the actual producer bytes through the shared zero-hardware integration gate.

workstreams.title: Coordinate continuity, motion assurance, and zero-write simulation
workstreams.objective: Trace named model targets through deterministic coordinate checks and zero-write planning while proving downstream physical stages remain blocked.
workstreams.current_result: Synthetic named-target routes and shared shadow paths are reproducible and zero-write; missing physical calibration or qualification blocks execution admission.
limitations: Passing simulation is not measured reachability, collision clearance, contact success, or controller qualification.
Independent keyboard outcome verification remains required.
workstreams.next_gate: Combine physically qualified perception with current calibration and configuration evidence, then run one zero-movement shadow batch before any physical review.

workstreams.title: External model artifacts and physical-camera qualification readiness
workstreams.objective: Preserve exact checkpoint identity and provide a strict process for collecting, separating, and preflighting final-camera localization evidence.
workstreams.current_result: Physical-camera and parked-pose protocols, deterministic retained-package indexing, and strict file-backed preflight are implemented; retained qualification and preflight receipts remain explicitly incomplete/blocked because no campaign package exists.
limitations: Artifact identity is not model qualification.
The four retained camera/support originals and commissioned transforms are still required.
Parked-pose evidence remains absent; the evaluator authenticates record structure and bindings but does not establish custody of the evidence behind supplied hashes.
File-backed indexing and preflight prove retained-byte integrity and declared bindings only; custody labels, physical originality, and measurement truth still require owner authentication.
workstreams.next_gate: Retain the ARM-071 physical originals and an authorized parked-pose campaign package with externally authenticated custody declarations, build its deterministic index, run file preflight, then evaluate the unchanged campaign without treating any receipt as deployment authority.

workstreams.title: AI documentation, test ownership, and evidence governance
workstreams.objective: Keep AI procedures, source ownership, tests, retained evidence, limitations, and next dependencies discoverable and machine checked.
workstreams.current_result: Every tracked AI test has one documented workstream owner, and the registry audit verifies all referenced paths and zero-authority fields.
limitations: Structural documentation coverage does not prove model correctness or physical readiness.
Workers must still update results and limitations when behavior changes.
workstreams.next_gate: Run the registry audit in repository CI and require registry updates whenever tracked AI tests or workstream ownership change.
